label: Baseline cohort value added
description: Controls for grade-4 achievement and subject × cohort fixed effects. Weighted by grade-10 tested students; standard errors clustered by commune.

label: Also control for grade-4 private share
description: Adds the cohort’s grade-4 private share to the baseline specification. Weighted by grade-10 tested students; standard errors clustered by commune.

label: Reading only
description: Reading outcome with reading baseline achievement and cohort fixed effects. Weighted by grade-10 tested students; standard errors clustered by commune.

label: Math only
description: Math outcome with math baseline achievement and cohort fixed effects. Weighted by grade-10 tested students; standard errors clustered by commune.

label: Cohort value added + commune fixed effects
description: Adds commune fixed effects to the cohort design. The near-zero estimate is imprecise. This removes persistent differences across communes and uses much less private-share variation. Observation and cluster counts are not reported in the source paragraph.

label: Panel: commune fixed effects
description: Main panel specification, with commune and grade × subject × year fixed effects. Weighted by tested students; errors clustered by commune.

label: Panel: grade 4
description: Grade-4 sample. Commune and subject × year fixed effects; tested-student weights and commune-clustered standard errors.

label: Panel: grade 10
description: Grade-10 sample. Commune and subject × year fixed effects; tested-student weights and commune-clustered standard errors.

label: Panel: reading
description: Reading sample, with commune and grade × year fixed effects. Tested-student weights and commune-clustered standard errors.

label: Panel: math
description: Math sample, with commune and grade × year fixed effects. Tested-student weights and commune-clustered standard errors.

label: Panel: commune × grade fixed effects
description: Robustness specification replacing commune fixed effects with commune × grade fixed effects. The estimation sample differs by one observation.

label: Long difference: grade 4
description: Grade-4 long difference with baseline controls. This is the grade corresponding to Hsieh and Urquiola’s test-score evidence.

label: Long difference: grade 10
description: Grade-10 long difference with baseline controls. This extends the comparison to a later grade.

label: Panel: Greater Santiago as one market
description: Main commune-FE panel specification with retained Greater Santiago communes aggregated into one market.

label: Panel: Metropolitan Region excluded
description: Main commune-FE panel specification excluding the Metropolitan Region.

label: Cohort VA: Greater Santiago as one market
description: Cohort value added with retained Greater Santiago communes aggregated into one market.

label: Cohort VA: Metropolitan Region excluded
description: Cohort value added excluding the Metropolitan Region.

label: Exposure measured at grade 4
description: Private share at grade 4, controlling for baseline achievement and subject × cohort fixed effects. Common sample; grade-10 tested-student weights and commune-clustered errors.

label: Average exposure in grades 5–10
description: Average annual private share over grades 5–10. Same baseline control, weights, fixed effects, and common sample.

label: Average exposure in grades 5–9
description: Average private share over grades 5–9, measured entirely before the outcome year. Same baseline control, weights, fixed effects, and common sample.

label: Exposure measured at grade 10
description: Endpoint private share. Same baseline control, weights, fixed effects, and common sample. This table rounds the baseline standard error to 2.47.
